description: This file defines the OutpostsAccessPointArn class, which represents and processes Amazon S3 Outposts access point ARNs, including parsing, validation, and data retrieval methods.

classes.name: OutpostsAccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents an AWS S3 Outposts access point ARN, providing methods for parsing, validation, and access to ARN components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into an OutpostsAccessPointArn object by utilizing the parent parse method and extracting outpost-specific data.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Returns the outpost ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: getAccesspointName
methods.description: Returns the access point name component of the ARN.

methods.name: parseOutpostData
methods.description: Processes the resource identifier string to extract outpost ID, access point type, name, and any additional resource data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ARN data array to ensure it conforms to the expected structure for S3 Outposts access point ARNs.
